module_summary: AXI central DMA: a read FSM splits descriptors into 4K/burst-bounded AXI read bursts, a write FSM realigns read data into an output FIFO feeding AXI writes, and a status FIFO reports completion.

anchors.name: read_state_reg
anchors.why: Read FSM: accepts descriptor, computes write burst length, issues AXI read requests

anchors.name: axi_state_reg
anchors.why: Write FSM: issues AW, streams read data into write FIFO, pushes status

anchors.name: s_axis_desc_valid
anchors.why: Descriptor input valid; accepted in read FSM idle state

anchors.name: s_axis_desc_ready
anchors.why: Descriptor ready, asserted when idle, enabled and status slots available

anchors.name: m_axi_rdata
anchors.why: AXI read data, shifted for alignment and forwarded to write data

anchors.name: m_axi_wdata
anchors.why: AXI write data output from the output FIFO register

anchors.name: m_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: AXI read address valid issued in READ_STATE_REQ

anchors.name: m_axi_araddr
anchors.why: AXI read burst address from read_addr_reg

anchors.name: m_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: AXI write address valid issued when write FSM takes a command

anchors.name: m_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: AXI write burst address from command register

anchors.name: m_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: AXI read data valid advancing input cycle counters

anchors.name: m_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: AXI write data valid from output FIFO stage

anchors.name: m_axis_desc_status_valid
anchors.why: Descriptor completion status valid after final write response

anchors.name: axi_cmd_valid_reg
anchors.why: Internal command valid from read FSM to write FSM

anchors.name: out_fifo_wdata
anchors.why: Output FIFO buffering aligned write data before AXI W channel

anchors.name: status_fifo_tag
anchors.why: Status FIFO storing tags of in-flight write bursts

anchors.name: m_axi_rready
anchors.why: AXI read ready, gated by output FIFO space and input activity

anchors.name: m_axi_wready
anchors.why: AXI write ready draining output FIFO

anchors.name: m_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: Write response valid, pops status FIFO

anchors.name: m_axi_bready
anchors.why: Write response ready while status FIFO non-empty

anchors.name: m_axi_wstrb
anchors.why: Write byte strobes for first/last partial cycles

anchors.name: m_axi_wlast
anchors.why: Last beat of write burst

anchors.name: m_axi_awlen
anchors.why: Write burst length from command output cycle count

anchors.name: m_axi_arlen
anchors.why: Read burst length from transfer word count

anchors.name: s_axis_desc_read_addr
anchors.why: Descriptor source address loaded into read_addr_reg

anchors.name: s_axis_desc_write_addr
anchors.why: Descriptor destination address loaded into write_addr_reg

anchors.name: s_axis_desc_len
anchors.why: Descriptor transfer length loaded into op word counter

anchors.name: m_axis_desc_status_tag
anchors.why: Completed descriptor tag from status FIFO

anchors.name: m_axis_desc_status_error
anchors.why: Completion error code from read/write AXI responses

anchors.name: enable
anchors.why: Enables acceptance of new descriptors

anchors.name: read_addr_reg
anchors.why: Current read address advanced per issued read burst

anchors.name: write_addr_reg
anchors.why: Current write address advanced per write command

anchors.name: op_word_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining bytes of whole descriptor operation

anchors.name: axi_word_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining bytes of current write burst to be read

anchors.name: tr_word_count_reg
anchors.why: Byte count of current read burst

anchors.name: axi_cmd_addr_reg
anchors.why: Write address of queued command for write FSM

anchors.name: axi_cmd_output_cycle_count_reg
anchors.why: Command write beat count, becomes awlen

anchors.name: input_cycle_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining read beats in current transfer

anchors.name: output_cycle_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining write beats in current transfer

anchors.name: input_active_reg
anchors.why: Read beats still expected; gates rready and counters

anchors.name: output_active_reg
anchors.why: Write beats still to produce

anchors.name: bubble_cycle_reg
anchors.why: Unaligned transfer needs extra input cycle before output

anchors.name: first_input_cycle_reg
anchors.why: Marks first read beat for bubble handling

anchors.name: first_output_cycle_reg
anchors.why: Marks first write beat, applies first-cycle strobe mask

anchors.name: output_last_cycle_reg
anchors.why: Last write beat: sets wlast, pushes status, returns FSM idle

anchors.name: last_transfer_reg
anchors.why: Current burst is the descriptor's final one

anchors.name: offset_reg
anchors.why: Byte offset selecting read data shift amount

anchors.name: first_cycle_offset_reg
anchors.why: First beat strobe offset

anchors.name: last_cycle_offset_reg
anchors.why: Last beat strobe offset

anchors.name: shift_axi_rdata
anchors.why: Realigned read data combining current and saved read words

anchors.name: save_axi_rdata_reg
anchors.why: Previous read beat saved for unaligned shifting

anchors.name: transfer_in_save
anchors.why: Enables saving read data beat

anchors.name: m_axi_wvalid_int
anchors.why: Write enable into output FIFO

anchors.name: m_axi_wready_int
anchors.why: Internal ready from output FIFO not half full

anchors.name: out_fifo_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Output FIFO write pointer

anchors.name: out_fifo_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Output FIFO read pointer

anchors.name: out_fifo_half_full_reg
anchors.why: Half-full flag throttling read data acceptance

anchors.name: out_fifo_full
anchors.why: Blocks FIFO writes when full

anchors.name: out_fifo_empty
anchors.why: Blocks FIFO reads when empty

anchors.name: status_fifo_resp
anchors.why: Status FIFO storing read response per burst

anchors.name: status_fifo_last
anchors.why: Status FIFO last-burst flag deciding status valid

anchors.name: status_fifo_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Status FIFO write pointer

anchors.name: status_fifo_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Status FIFO read pointer, advanced on write response

anchors.name: status_fifo_we
anchors.why: Pushes status entry at end of write burst

anchors.name: rresp_reg
anchors.why: Sticky read error response

anchors.name: bresp_reg
anchors.why: Sticky write error response

anchors.name: tag_reg
anchors.why: Tag of active transfer written into status FIFO

anchors.name: active_count_reg
anchors.why: Counts in-flight bursts to bound status FIFO occupancy

anchors.name: active_count_av_reg
anchors.why: Status slot available; gates descriptor acceptance and commands

anchors.name: inc_active
anchors.why: Increments active count on new command

anchors.name: dec_active
anchors.why: Decrements active count on write completion

groups.name: Descriptor input
groups.description: Accepts copy descriptors with source, destination, length and tag

groups.name: Read request FSM
groups.description: Splits descriptor into 4K-bounded bursts and issues AXI read requests

groups.name: Command handoff
groups.description: Single-entry command register passing burst parameters from read FSM to write FSM

groups.name: Write transfer FSM
groups.description: Issues AW, counts read/write beats, generates strobes and last

groups.name: Alignment datapath
groups.description: Shifts read data by byte offset to destination alignment

groups.name: Output write FIFO
groups.description: 32-entry FIFO decoupling aligned data from AXI W channel

groups.name: Status tracking
groups.description: Status FIFO matching write responses to bursts, reporting tag and error

groups.name: AXI master ports
groups.description: AXI4 read and write master channels
